definitions.short: Nechemjah , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H5166. Nechemyah נְחֶמְיָה proper name, masculine ( Yah comforts , ᵐ5 Νεεμιας ( +? ), etc.; — proper name נחמיה(וׅ on Israel scarab in BM, ClGann Jas 1883, Fév.-Mars. 156 No. 42 ); — 1 the son of Hachaliah, governor of Judah under Artaxerxes Longimanus Neh 1:1 ; 8:9 ; 10:2 ; 12:26 , 47 . 2 ruler of half the district of Bethzur Neh 3:16 . 3 one of twelve heads of people who returned with Zerubbabel Ezra 2:2 = Neh 7:7 .
